entries.name: Onigiri (rice ball)
entries.style: low-poly, colour-map texture flattened to flat colours; Kenney's rice ball is taller than wide, so at 0.085 m tall it is 0.075 m wide and 0.053 m thick

source.author: Kenney
source.note: Wave-1 row 189 named a Quaternius static model on poly.pizza (Cloudflare challenge, off limits); Quaternius's Ultimate Food Pack on OpenGameArt has nigiri, sushi rolls and sashimi but no onigiri. Kenney Food Kit `rice-ball` is the onigiri: a rounded white rice triangle with a nori strip wrapped up both faces and under the base. Turned 90 degrees so a triangle face points +Z. Colours (noon): rice in practical with a sky shade; the nori is one flat tone (hair) and drawn without its own ink hull, since a sheet that thin made its hull show through as a diagonal split; the rice's outline still closes the silhouette. Static, no clips.
